run_eval_runner: run an EvalRunner with a dataloader and eval unit to evaluate a model
create_eval_runner: create an EvalRunner instance with a dataloader, eval unit, and optional callbacks
review_eval_runner_run: review the EvalRunner run method that delegates to torchtnt evaluate with the eval unit and dataloader
refactor_eval_runner_callbacks: refactor the EvalRunner to support custom callback classes for evaluation hooks
summarize_eval_runner: summarize the EvalRunner class that wraps torchtnt evaluate for model evaluation workflows
